$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema. options follow defaultRunOptions in store.json. Tasks marked publish false stay saved but off the Store: the account publishes at most 100 pages across all actors, so each actor keeps 2 or more by its earnings and search traffic (2026-11-11).
